cpu_pinning.host_isolation: best-effort process-affinity pin on a shared host
cpu_pinning.disclosure: Process affinity pinned (children inherit), but the HOST is still shared: other processes may run on the same physical core. CPU pinning plus idle-baseline subtraction, not isolation, is what these numbers have.

selftest.invalidate_rerun_policy: An attempt invalidated by host noise is discarded and rerun (plan.html sections 10-11). No threshold is loosened; after max_attempts the verdict is FAIL (blocking).

logic.method: seeded deterministic mock-clock series through phase0_bench.stats()

runs.detection_method: paired per-iteration differences (P_i - B_i); rel > 3% AND median(diff) > 3*MAD(diff)/2
